column3: CI runs on Instabox: a dispatcher VM takes the repo webhook and leases 5 of 10 persistent 8 vCPU runners per head SHA (one checks runner, four 6-worker test shards), each reused with a clean checkout instead of a fresh VM per job
column4: Keyur: replace Actions with Instabox VMs, under 60 s from push to last status. A VM from a snapshot took 40-175 s to create when several started at once (3 s alone from a template), while a paused runner resumes in about 3 s
column5: PR 123 head (fast test files) on 4 shards: 48.5 s from push, runners ready 4.9 s after it; main before #123 (3a365a15): 69.4 s
